text: 亚太媒体高端论坛5日在广东深圳开幕。中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席开幕式并发表主旨演讲。中共中央政治局委员、广东省委书记黄坤明出席并致辞。与会嘉宾认为，习近平主席提出构建亚太共同体的重大主张，为共建开放型亚太经济、推动亚太共同繁荣提供了重要指引。今年是亚太经合组织（APEC）“中国年”，中国将举办亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议，相信在各方支持下，会议将取得丰硕成果，推动亚太合作迈上新台阶。（央视新闻）
text_en: The Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on September 5. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech. Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province, attended and delivered remarks. Participants noted that President Xi Jinping's major proposal on building an Asia-Pacific community provides important guidance for jointly fostering an open Asia-Pacific economy and promoting common prosperity. This year is the 'China Year' for APEC, and China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting. It is believed that with support from all parties, the meeting will yield fruitful results and elevate Asia-Pacific cooperation to new heights. (CCTV News)
